sources.repositoryReadmeRights: README states GPL version 3; current LICENSE file is MIT. Source compositions retain individual copyright notices.

policy.selection: Only original-catalogue title matches. Prefer complete Real version, then declared default, then remaining encoded versions; first fully validated arrangement per composition.
policy.tonic: Explicit source key/mode only. Source declaration mode differing from original composition harmonic mode is excluded for review; relative-major signatures are not silently treated as actual tonic.
policy.skips: Blank chord-label skips hold preceding harmony with explicit continuation provenance; rests are NC and initial blanks remain NC.
policy.navigation: Textual DC/DS/Coda and pickups excluded. No inferred return or invented note. Written volta and alternatives unfolded by LilyPond.
policy.timing: Compiled melody MIDI and independently unfolded chord AST must have equal total duration; every explicit barcheck must be on the fixed meter grid.
policy.sourceChordValidation: Direct syntax mapping must exist in Impro-Visor vocabulary and agree exactly with the LilyPond-compiled pitch-class set including explicit slash bass.
policy.alignment: Entries are whole source arrangements. Existing roadmap compatibility still requires exact root/rhythm check; title match alone never authorizes melody overlay.
